text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Zenno Rob Roy was pointing, 
there was a claw machine filled with 
plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...If I could display this on my 
bookshelf, it feels like it would brighten 
up the whole room..."
choice_data_list: Shall I go get it for you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no... I'd feel bad accepting 
that...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, leave it to me!
Don't worry, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A-Are you really sure about this...!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then... um, please do your best! I'm 
cheering for you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
